grounded.context: review statement of checkpoint pathways
grounded.evidence_quote: Checkpoint kinase-2 and Chk1 inactivate CDC25 phosphatases, culminating in cell cycle arrest.
grounded.location: Cell cycle checkpoint pathways. Once DNA damage is identified with the aid of sensors, the checkpoint transducers ATM and ATR undergo conformational change and/or localisation, resulting in their activation. Together with their mediators, ATM and ATR activate a series of downstream molecules, including the checkpoint transducer kinases. Checkpoint kinase-2 and Chk1 inactivate CDC25 phosphatases, culminating in cell cycle arrest.
